# Pxld

Pxld gives Obsidian a pixel-art interface built around the Pixel Square font and blocky, game-like visuals, recorded as a desktop theme. Font and accent colors are configurable through Style Settings, and both dark and light modes are offered.

![Pxld screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lina674/Pxld-Obsidian-Theme/HEAD/merged_diagonal_resized.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Pxld"
    author: "lina674"
    repo:   "lina674/Pxld-Obsidian-Theme"
    slug:   "pxld"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/pxld"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/lina674/Pxld-Obsidian-Theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lina674/Pxld-Obsidian-Theme/HEAD/merged_diagonal_resized.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a pixel-art inspired interface featuring the Pixel Square font and blocky, game-like visuals for desktop. Customize font and accent colors and switch between dark and light modes using Style Settings for a nostalgic, retro UI."
}
```
